label: rem:perpetual-obstruction-depth-omega
title: The perpetual obstruction as a single surreal grade
html:
Remark. The perpetual obstruction as a single surreal grade

The motivic perpetual obstruction theorem asserts that the obstruction \kappa_n is non-trivial at every finite tower level n. Under the surreal lift, this infinite family of non-vanishing statements is the shadow of a single graded coefficient.

Recall the substrate identification \varepsilon = q - 1 \leftrightarrow 1/\omega (surreal blow-up calculus), under which the level-n contribution sits at \varepsilon-order n. The element

  \varepsilon^{\omega} \;=\; \omega^{-\omega},
  \qquad
  0 \;<\; \varepsilon^{\omega} \;<\; \varepsilon^{n}
  \quad\text{for every finite } n,

is the unique grade lying beneath the entire finite tower — the depth-\omega slot of the Conway normal form. It exists in \mathbf{No} precisely because \mathbf{No} admits Hahn expansions with surreal exponents, and has no counterpart in the archimedean Hahn line \mathbb{R}((\varepsilon^{\mathbb{Q}})), whose exponents are finite.

Interpretation. Perpetuity of the obstruction is equivalent to the surreal-lifted obstruction \widehat{\kappa} carrying a non-zero component at the depth-\omega grade:

  \kappa_n \neq 0 \ \ (\forall\, n \in \mathbb{N})
  \qquad\Longleftrightarrow\qquad
  [\varepsilon^{\omega}]\,\widehat{\kappa} \;\neq\; 0 .

The universally-quantified family collapses to one non-vanishing graded coefficient. The surreal field thereby gives an obstruction beyond every finite order — a non-perturbative datum invisible to each \varepsilon^{n} truncation, in the manner of a transseries beyond-all-orders term — an explicit home as a single element of the value group.

Scope. The equivalence is a re-grading, not a new theorem. By Mostow rigidity the volume series \mathrm{Vol} = \sum_n \Phi_n converges in \mathbb{R} (Chern–Simons evaluation faithfulness), so the archimedean value is recovered by the standard part and no surreal arithmetic is needed to evaluate it. The depth-\omega statement is a single graded witness for perpetuity — the narrowing — not an archimedean obligation.
